claim: Patients show a larger evoked response than controls in the time window in which the two groups' responses differ: the mean amplitude over a window of 10 consecutive samples is at least 0.5 microvolts greater for patients than for controls, and a one-sided Welch t test of that difference is significant at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: evoked-response amplitude (microvolts) of each participant at each time sample after stimulus onset, time samples in order
True for a patient, False for a control participant

claim: A shrunken-centroid classifier built from the 1000 gene-expression measurements separates patients who respond to the treatment from those who do not, with an area under the ROC curve of at least 0.65 on new patients.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in the tumour of each patient
True when the patient responds to the treatment

claim: Among women whose menopausal symptom index at the start of the trial was at least 20 points, active hormone therapy lowers the index more than placebo does: the mean fall in the index (start minus week 12) is at least 3 points greater on active therapy than on placebo, and a one-sided Welch t test of that difference between the two arms is significant at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: menopausal symptom index of each woman at the start of the trial (higher is worse)
symptom index of each woman at week 12
True if the woman was randomised to active hormone therapy, False if to placebo

claim: A classifier built from the 10 daily indicators predicts whether the series rises over the following day with an accuracy of at least 0.58 on later days.

data_keys.meaning: 10 indicators observed on each day, days in chronological order
True when the series rises over the day that follows

claim: The treatment raises invertebrate abundance in the field plots: abundance is higher in treated plots than in control plots, and a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test comparing the abundances of the two groups gives p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: number of individuals counted in a sample from each plot on each weekly sampling date, dates in order
whether the plot received the treatment

sizes: plots = 12; dates = 12 (abundance: 12 x 12 = 144 values; treated: 12 values)

claim: In the cortical voxels where participants respond to the task, the response is at least 0.25 percent signal change: the mean task effect, averaged over those voxels and across participants, is at least 0.25, and a one-sided one-sample t test across participants of the voxel-averaged effect is significant at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: task effect (task minus rest, percent signal change) of each cortical voxel in each participant

claim: A classifier built from the 12 clinical measurements detects at least 60% of the patients who have the less frequent outcome among new patients (sensitivity of at least 0.60).

data_keys.meaning: 12 clinical measurements of each patient
True when the patient has the less frequent of the two outcomes

claim: The compound raises the share of cells that respond to stimulation: the proportion of responding cells is higher in treated wells than in untreated wells, and a test of the difference between the two groups gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: whether each imaged cell of each well showed a calcium response to the stimulus
whether the well was given the compound before stimulation

sizes: wells = 12; cells = 150 (responded: 12 x 150 = 1800 values; treated: 12 values)

claim: In patients attending a hypertension clinic, left ventricular mass adds explanatory power for systolic blood pressure beyond body surface area: the gain in R-squared when left ventricular mass is added to a linear regression of systolic pressure on body surface area is at least 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: Left ventricular mass of each patient from echocardiography, in g.
Body surface area of each patient, in square metres.
Resting systolic blood pressure of each patient, in mmHg.

sizes: patients = 300; lv_mass, body_surface_area and systolic_bp each have shape (300,).

claim: In a cohort of patients, a linear regression of the clinical outcome score on the first 10 principal components of the biomarker panel predicts the outcome of new patients with an R-squared of at least 0.15, estimated by 5-fold cross-validation.

data_keys.meaning: baseline blood biomarker concentrations (log scale) measured on each patient
clinical outcome score of each patient at 12-month follow-up

claim: Neurons that are least active at rest increase their firing more with the manipulation than neurons that are most active at rest: ranking the 240 neurons by firing rate in the resting recording, the mean change in rate (post-manipulation minus pre-manipulation) of the lowest third exceeds that of the highest third by at least 1.0 spikes/s, and a one-sided Welch t test of that difference is significant at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: firing rate (spikes/s) of each neuron in a resting recording
firing rate (spikes/s) of each neuron before the manipulation
firing rate (spikes/s) of each neuron after the manipulation

claim: A regression on the 10 session measurements predicts a participant's score in a session, with a Pearson correlation of at least 0.30 between predicted and observed scores for new participants.

data_keys.meaning: 10 measurements recorded in each session of each participant
score of the participant in that session

claim: In women treated for osteoporosis, first-year responders keep gaining more bone than first-year non-responders: women whose bone mineral density rose over the first year (from the start of treatment to the first 12-month scan) gain at least 0.5 percentage points more over the second year (percentage change from the second 12-month scan to the 24-month scan) than women whose density fell over the first year, and a one-sided Welch t test of that difference between the two groups of women is significant at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: bone mineral density of each woman at the start of treatment (g/cm2)
bone mineral density at the 12-month visit, first of two scans taken at that visit (g/cm2)
bone mineral density at the 12-month visit, second of two scans taken at that visit (g/cm2)
bone mineral density at the 24-month visit (g/cm2)

claim: A statistical classifier built from the 30 annual indicators of a country distinguishes the country-years in which a civil war begins from the country-years in which none begins, with an area under the ROC curve of at least 0.75 on new country-years.

data_keys.meaning: 30 annual political, economic and demographic indicators of the country in that year
True when a civil war begins in that country-year

claim: The training programme improves task accuracy more than the control activity: the mean change in accuracy (post minus pre) is larger in the trained group than in the control group, and a two-sample t test of the difference between the two groups' mean changes gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: task accuracy (proportion correct) of each subject before the programme
task accuracy (proportion correct) of each subject after the programme
whether the subject took part in the training programme (true) or in the control activity (false)

sizes: subjects = 40 (pre, post and trained: 40 values each)
